per_query_caveat: Inherits the upstream's behaviour: query() regenerates InspiRING packing keys on every call, so client_query_gen_ms and query_bytes include per-query key generation and shipping. inspire-raven's do not. CODE PATH: in this codebase respond_with_variant() dispatches OnePacking and TwoPacking to the same function (respond_inspiring), so requesting TwoPacking actually runs InsPIRe^1, not InsPIRe^2. Raven's fork patched this exact fall-through. The row is therefore not executing the same algorithm as inspire-raven's TwoPacking row even though both are labelled two-packing.
notes: A second fork of the deleted igor53627/inspire-rs, diverged 2026-04-24 — after the upstream's last substantive commit but before Raven's patches. Declares the same crate name and version (inspire 0.2.0) and exports an identical public API, so it is benchmarked through the same shared driver as inspire-upstream; the interesting question is whether the fork changed anything measurable. Last pushed 2026-04-24.
measurement_caveat: Run with 1 seed x 4 measured iterations instead of the 3 x 16 used for inspire-raven. This implementation's per-query cost is ~2000x higher (4.0 s vs 1.9 ms at 2^20 x 8 B on the reference machine), so the default counts are unfinishable at the larger cells. Fewer iterations lowers confidence in the number; it does not change what is being measured. The counts actually used are recorded in params.scheme_params.
